POST /api/v1/inbox/extract: Fetch a URL and return a preview (contentJson + extractedText). Follow with POST /api/v1/inbox using those fields.
POST /api/v1/inbox: Capture an item. `source` defaults to `manual`. Send `markdown` or `extractedHtml` (or `contentJson`); the server stores TipTap `contentJson`. Priority: contentJson > html > markdown > extractedText. Optional header `Idempotency-Key` (64 hex chars); required when `source` is `extension`.
GET /api/v1/inbox/:id/markdown: Article body as Markdown from the stored TipTap doc. Empty string when there is no body. List/sync omit the body.
POST /api/v1/tasks: Create a task. `listId` must be a user or inbox list UUID, not a `smart:*` id. Call GET /api/v1/lists first. All-day due: `dueYmd` as YYYY-MM-DD in the task timezone (account default). Mutually exclusive with `dueAt`.
POST /api/v1/tasks/from-text: Parse natural language into a task using the account LLM settings.
GET /api/v1/tasks: List tasks in a list. `listId` may be a UUID or `smart:today` / `smart:inbox` / `smart:upcoming` / `smart:someday` / `smart:done`.
GET /api/v1/today: Today's dashboard: open threads, tasks, pulse, and now-recommendations.
GET /api/v1/reports/current: Get or create the report for the period containing `at` (defaults to now).
POST /api/v1/reports/:id/generate: Queue an agent job that writes the daily report notes from that day's completed, carried, captured and habit data. Daily reports only.
POST /api/v1/agent/cluster: Queue outcome.cluster (organize unassigned tasks into threads). 202 `{ status: queued|disabled, jobId }`.
POST /api/v1/tokens: Create a personal access token. The `token` field is returned once.
GET /api/v1/tokens/:id/access: Call log for one token, newest first, retained 30 days.
GET /api/v1/app: Latest GitHub Release catalog (Android APK + desktop installers). `latest` is null when none is published.
GET /api/v1/app/android: Latest Android APK from GitHub Releases (`ximing/vital` by default). `android` is null when no release with an `.apk` asset is published. Public; the APK is downloaded from `apkUrl` (GitHub `browser_download_url`).
